entities.name: Revin Skoros
entities.description: Criminal Zombie Wizard on Alara, formerly a brilliant human aethermage of Grixis.

entities.name: Banath'thur
entities.description: Demon who tempted Skoros with exotic mana bonds.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Skoros originated.

events.summary: Revin Skoros travels the plane studying the art of the mana bond.
events.quote: He is said to have traveled the plane studying the art of the mana bond

events.summary: The demon Banath'thur tempts Skoros, who becomes one of the Damned.
events.quote: This caused Skoros to become one of the Damned

events.summary: Skoros now stalks Alara following potent mana and corrupting power sources.
events.quote: He is now known to stalk Alara

relations.quote: he encountered the demon Banath'thur who tempted Skoros
